build: composer install inside /var/azuracast/www and inside /var/azuracast/www/plugins/utils-plugin; invoke via `azuracast_cli utils:import-media <dir> [--proceed]` or `azuracast_cli utils:create-station <name> [--proceed]`
current_state: Recent commits added SQLite-backed song metadata enrichment (prod.db + SongdbReader); composer.lock currently shows uncommitted modifications on main branch
entrypoints: events.php (registers console commands and event listeners)
notes: Plugin targets AzuraCast and depends on its event system and StationPlaylistFolderRepository
prod.db (79MB) is committed in the repo — large binary asset
SongdbReader registered with priority -1 on Event\Media\ReadMetadata
Part of broader azuracast-amiga project integrating UADE music player
purpose: AzuraCast plugin providing CLI commands to bulk-create stations/playlists and import media from a directory tree, plus song metadata enrichment from a SongDB SQLite database (developed for the azuracast-amiga project to support 200+ Amiga music formats via UADE)
structure: src/Command/ — console commands CreateStation and ImportMedia
src/EventHandler/Songdb/ — SongdbReader hooks into Media\ReadMetadata to enrich metadata
prod.db — 79MB SQLite database of Amiga song metadata
